programme.title: Psychos In Love
programme.desc: Joe (Carmine Capobianco) runs a strip club and Kate (Debi Thibeault) is an attractive manicurist. After bonding over their mutual dislike of grapes, they discover another commonality: both of them are bloodthirsty serial killers. Gorman Bechard's PSYCHOS IN LOVE is an absurd, home grown horror-comedy, which alternates between gratuitous killing scenes and self-aware parody of romantic comedies.

programme.title: The Woman in the Fifth

programme.title: Siren
programme.desc: Leigh has a unique power: every man who encounters her sees his ultimate fantasy, and falls uncontrollably in love with her.

programme.title: Honeymoon
programme.desc: A newlywed couple's idyllic country-lake honeymoon descends into chaos.

programme.title: Hallowed Ground
programme.desc: When her car breaks down in a small town, Liz Chambers (Jaimie Alexander) meets journalist Sarah Austin (Hudson Leick), who tells her about the town's bloodthirsty past. After Sarah is killed in a cornfield when a scarecrow comes to life, Liz realizes the spirit of the evil preacher can jump from one body to another, and she must elude the townspeople who are helping him.

programme.title: Lyle

programme.title: The Endless

programme.title: The Truth About Emanuel

programme.desc: A family sequesters themselves in a high-rise apartment after the mysterious death of their daughter Lilith. Haunted by their past, the survivor's lies, deceits and strange behavior will have you asking: who killed Lilith and who will be next?

programme.title: Secrets
programme.desc: After her mother's passing, Sammy, a resilient single mother, grapples with the looming threat of a breakdown while keeping her mysterious past hidden.
